# Module `time`

time - wall-clock and monotonic clocks plus sleep.

Thin wrappers over the runtime's `__vyb_time_*` functions in
`runtime/vyb_runtime.c` (POSIX `clock_gettime` / `nanosleep`). All values are
plain `Int` (epoch nanoseconds/millis/seconds, monotonic ms), so the module is
allocation/pointer-free.

Usage:
  import time::{time_epoch_secs, time_mono_millis, sleep_ms}
  start = time_mono_millis()
  sleep_ms(20)
  elapsed = time_mono_millis() - start   // ~20 ms

Epoch values are wall-clock based (useful for timestamps); the monotonic
source (time_mono_millis) ignores system clock changes and is the right choice
for measuring intervals / timeouts.
